name: Paragraphs Collection
description: Experimental plugins for rich paragraph types.
project_description:
Paragraphs introduced a powerful plugin system to attach behaviors to paragraph types.

 This project is a collection of EXPERIMENTS to provide plugins for a rich variety of paragraph types.

These plugins are available or in progress:

 
 Grids 
 Sliders 
 Style selection (a set of predefined styles) 
 Background 
 Lock editing 
 Visibility per language 
 
 We are currently focussing on ONE implementation per concept. We might add more plugins for other frameworks if multiple approaches make sense to the same concept.

 At the same time, plugins only work out of the box, if we have example paragraph types.

The project starts as a collection of paragraph types to use the plugin concepts and later evolve into our larger set of paragraph types. At the later stage, users might pick what types they want to install in a wizard. For now, the collection will just install all types.

 The Paragraphs Library (reusable Paragraphs) is also part of Paragraphs Collection.
